what: The no-regression rule rejected e13 and protected a rank point

e13.mechanism: held then dropped at frame 427 of 922; 46% of frames inside 10 cm

why_it_matters: e13 is a clip that tracks tightly but scores low AUC -- shipped MPPE 4.98 cm. The transfer traded that away: +0.0641 of AUC for +25.23 cm of MPPE. On the entry that is +0.0021 of mean AUC, still short of wte09fl's 0.54183, against +0.84 cm of mean MPPE -- which would take us from 12.20 to 13.04 and hand back the 10th place on tier1-mppe we had just taken from Rohit Pardeshi at 13.04419.
the_general_point: The rule is 'AUC improves AND no other board regresses', and this is the first time the second clause has done real work on a transfer clip. Across the whole warm-start programme it had never cost a board point; here it saved one. A rule that only ever agrees with the obvious choice is untested -- this one has now been tested.
